'''Saffia''' was one of the three largest [[City/Legends|cities]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]].

==History==
These [[City/Legends|cities]] were well known for anti-[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] tendencies and were home to some of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] wealthiest benefactors.<ref name="DB:ROT" /> [[Carannia/Legends|Carannia]] and [[Fiyarro]] were very similar to Saffia.<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>
